nom: BLUME Milky Fade Spot and Scar Serum

avis.texte: I normally never write reviews but i had to on this product! Ive used alot of brightening serums and they never truly faded my acne scars like this one has. This is my go to serum everynight and ive only been using it for a couple weeks and ive seen insane results with my dark spots / acne scars. I 100% recommend this product.

This milky fade serum is like magic in a jar. The more I use it I notice clear skin not so many dark spots and scars there fading. If you have never tried Blume I suggest you need to because you don't know what your missing its never to late.
I have only added the milky fade to my routine a couple of weeks ago but it has been a great addition and seems to be fading my acne scars!
This has seriously improved the overall look of my skin. The acne redness fades so much faster now, and my skin just looks more even!
This whole product line has genuinely transformed my skin like nothing before. I couldn't be happier.
This product felt great on my skin, but the next day I had tiny white bumps all over my face. Made me break out so bad :(

My holy grail!! I get so many compliments on my skin when I'm consistently using this serum. It evens out my skin tone and is very gentle on my skin. I've tried so many serums that end up breaking me out or leaving dry patches but the Milky Fade Serum makes my skin look amazing and feel so soft

my daughter's only been using the product for a couple weeks so it's hard to tell how effective it is yet but she's been using the meltdown line for a few months and we've noticed a huge difference in her breakouts, we've tried so many products in the last year since she's hit puberty and this line is the only skincare that has truly worked for her love love love Blume

I enjoyed how it made my skin feel, moisturized and calmed, but it made me break out. After 2 weeks of use alongside the meltdown cleanser and oil, I noticed my hormonal acne settling down but also new breakouts in unusual spots. I had an inkling it was the milky fade and took it out of the mix. The breakouts subsided. Just in case, I tried it again and the breakouts restarted. So I can confidently say the milky fade did not work for me. I love The rest of the hormonal acne kit though!

This product has not only faded newer/older acne scars, but has kept my complexion bright and even. I will be honest in saying that it doesn't make deeper set scars disappear, but they do soften some in texture. It also may take some time for more stubborn scars. Definitely can't live without Milky Fade!
This stuff really works. It has helped my boyfriend with his acne scars. He even puts it on when he starts to see a spot and it helps minimize the size.

Love my Blume products! I start with daydreamer face wash, then meltdown oil, then milky fade, and finish with the meltdown gel cream. I have tried so many acne products over the years and these are the only ones that really work. Not to mention great customer service. I am a repeat customer!

This is one of my holy grail products. I seriously hope Blume never discontinues this. I have struggled with acne in my 30s, and have tried everything - oral medications, creams, etc, without success. My face would end up burnt, red, and irritated. I tried Blume on a whim several years ago and never looked back. I absolutely love this product. It took a few months to really work (my skin was bad). It fades dark spots left behind by acne, and doesn't leave a residue on your face. I use this twice a day with the meltdown oil, and together, they have been a game changer for my skin. If you're on the fence, I highly highly recommend!
Helped clear my acne scars after a week! Noticeable difference

I love the packaging to start out with. Such a nice color and very easy to use and transport! I love how the serum feels on my skin and how it interacts with the other products. Since I started to use it I have noticed my acne scars fade and my acne has gotten in more control. Overall, this is a great product and I will definitely continue to use it!!

I have used Bio Oil for years to get rid of scars. It works, but takes a year to fade scars when used daily. Not this! My scars are fading quickly in a short amount of time. I bought a second bottle because it works so well.
I hate to say it, but my skin was completely inflamed by this product. I love the meltdown oil but within 24hrs of trying this for the first time, I had fine bumps all over my face.

avis.titre: Acne marks? This is for you!
avis.texte: The Milky Fade Serum by Blume is a game-changer. Lightweight, non-sticky, and packed with niacinamide + zinc to calm, brighten, and even out your skin. I saw results in just a few weeks. Glow-up in a bottle. Period.

I have been using this product for a few weeks now and have really noticed the redness in my face go down. This is something I've been self conscious about for years, so I'm thrilled I've finally found something that helps! This product also layers really well under other skincare or make up, I'll definitely be keeping it as a part of my daily routine!
Amazing! Goes on so smooth and has really reduced discoloration! Yay!
I never leave reviews for products, however I noticed a huge lightning in my acne scars after only two uses! It also seemed to make a few new pimples go down as well. Go get it!!!
Actually works at fading acne scars!! This is a must buy for anyone dealing with hyperpigmentation. Saw results in a week!
This fade spot will have you thinking it's magic. The texture is amazing and so are my results!. Being a brown skin girly it's helped so much with my hyperpigmentation.
I'm not usually one to truly stick to using a face product, well sticking to the same one. But this product really made a difference in my face and skin! Very happy with it.
a little pricey & didn't really see a big difference but i might need to use it for months?

A great lightweight serum! I use this on nights where I don't use retinol. Great texture, a bit sticky and gets tacky so you definitely need to put something overtop unless you like that feeling. That of course got me thinking it would be great under makeup since it's tacky, just make sure you let it really sink in like more than 5-10 minutes to fully fully absorb otherwise your makeup will get patchy. Love this for my nighttime routine!
I am so happy to have found this product. It feels so lovely when apply to my face, and has done wonders for my uneven skin tone

I have been using this product and I am not at all disappointed with the effect it has brought on my skin. Its very light weight, does the feel heavy or sticky at any point, ACTUALLY works. Dealing with acne marks is really tough but this product has made my life much easier. I would recommend this product to everyone who is facing acne marks, dark spots, hyperpigmentation issues, it really does the job and is not just another product that promises and doesnt work.
I've been using this on some old acne marks and it's actually fading them. My skin tone looks way more even now!

I absolutely loooove this serum! It comes in such a pretty bottle and the dispenser makes it feel more expensive than it actually is. I especially enjoy that the serum has very little fragrance, as I am very sensitive to strong smells. It seamlessly blends in with my other skincare products and is a great extra layer to protect my skin and decrease my acne.

avis.titre: I'll never not use this!!! Incredible
avis.texte: I'll never not use this product. Game changing if you have acne or acne scars. So moisturizing too. Love it so much

I've been using the Milky Fade Spot & Scar Fade Serum twice a day consistently, and I'm honestly so impressed with the results. My skin looks noticeably brighter and has a healthy glow. It feels super lightweight and smooth going on, and it layers well with the rest of my skincare. Definitely becoming a staple in my routine!

I've tried so many dark spot and acne scar treatments, but Blume Milky Fade is on another level. It has a super lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and doesn't irritate my skin at all. I've been using it consistently for a few weeks, and I can already see a big difference‚Äîsome of my old acne scars are visibly lighter, and my skin tone looks way more even overall. It also layers well under makeup and other products. Love the clean ingredients too. This is a new staple in my routine!

The consistency of Milky Fade is amazing, it's so smooth and silky! I actually really like how it is under my makeup, I feel like it almost provides an instant glow. I did see a reduction in my dark spots especially a pretty stubborn one that I've had for years, but the change wasn't as drastic as I had hoped for. Overall amazing product!

I love that this serum feels lightweight and is unscented. As someone with somewhat sensitive skin, I had zero issues introducing this product to my routine and have noticed my dark spots fading and brighter skin overall!

Looove the packaging! Didn't see much noticeable difference from using this for a few weeks except my skin looks a bit clearer! The first time I used this, I had a small cut on my finger and some of the product fell onto it and it STUNG which was a first for me. Otherwise I had no other issues with the serum!

I have been using this serum for a week and here are my thoughts. First of all, I love the packaging. This serum comes in a heavy purple bottle that feels luxurious. I love that the serum dispenser is a pump. It's a milky coloured serum that's lightly fragrant. Nothing too strong or too disturbing. It easily blends into the skin and is quickly absorbed. It layers beautifully with my other skincare products. I have rosacea and I'm always hesitant to try products containing vitamin C since it can be irritating. Thankfully, this serum did not irritate my skin and did not break me out. I love that this serum contains centella asiatica, an amazing calming ingredient for rosacea. I don't know which ingredient is responsible for this, but from the first use, I have noticed a glow on my face. My relatives also noticed and complimented my skin. This serum claims to fade scars and I'm really hoping it will help fade my post-acne scarring. I haven't noticed a drastic change yet, but my skin does look a bit smoother. I think I just found a new favourite skincare product. I will continue to use this serum regularly and I'm excited to see more results.

I love how light this feels on your skin and how there is no strong scent. My skin loves this product and has never looked brighter and clear. I would recommend this to all my girlies with scarring and spots.

This serum leaves my skin feeling and looking SO nice! I love adding this step into my skincare routine

avis.titre: It works but a little too well
avis.texte: I started using this about two weeks ago just to see if there would be any difference in my dark marks. Good news is, my spots are fading. Bad news is, this stuff is kind of burning my face? The instructions say to use 1-2 pumps daily after cleansing and use moisturizer and spf. If you have sensitive skin, maybe only do this once or twice a week at night and pump your face with moisturizer afterwards. It dries you out and makes your face peel, and sometimes stings a little. Like yes, my acne spots are going away, but now I have chemical burn scabbing on my cheeks and chin. Use it carefully and it could be a good experience, but be warned, it's potent stuff! DO NOT SKIP MOISTURIZER!
